# mutscan

![mutscan](reference/figures/mutscan.png)

  

  

`mutscan` is an R package to process, statistically analyse and
visualise multiplexed assays of variant effect data. The package is
under active development, and the functionality and user interface may
change. For more detailed information about how to run `mutscan`, please
consult the vignettes.

## Installation

`mutscan` is available from Bioconductor (from release 3.22) and can be
installed with:

``` r

# install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install("mutscan")
```

You can also install the development version of `mutscan` from GitHub
with:

``` r

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("fmicompbio/mutscan")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`calcNearestStringDist()`](https://fmicompbio.github.io/mutscan/reference/calcNearestStringDist.md)
  : Calculate distances to the nearest string
- [`calculateFitnessScore()`](https://fmicompbio.github.io/mutscan/reference/calculateFitnessScore.md)
  : Calculate fitness scores.
- [`calculateRelativeFC()`](https://fmicompbio.github.io/mutscan/reference/calculateRelativeFC.md)
  : Calculate logFCs relative to WT using edgeR
- [`collapseMutantsBySimilarity()`](https://fmicompbio.github.io/mutscan/reference/collapseMutantsBySimilarity.md)
  [`collapseMutantsByAA()`](https://fmicompbio.github.io/mutscan/reference/collapseMutantsBySimilarity.md)
  [`collapseMutants()`](https://fmicompbio.github.io/mutscan/reference/collapseMutantsBySimilarity.md)
  : Collapse mutants by similarity
- [`digestFastqs()`](https://fmicompbio.github.io/mutscan/reference/digestFastqs.md)
  : Read, filter and digest sequences from fastq file(s).
- [`generateQCReport()`](https://fmicompbio.github.io/mutscan/reference/generateQCReport.md)
  : Generate QC report
- [`groupSimilarSequences()`](https://fmicompbio.github.io/mutscan/reference/groupSimilarSequences.md)
  : Create a conversion table for collapsing similar sequences
- [`linkMultipleVariants()`](https://fmicompbio.github.io/mutscan/reference/linkMultipleVariants.md)
  : Process an experiment with multiple variable sequences
- [`plotDistributions()`](https://fmicompbio.github.io/mutscan/reference/plotDistributions.md)
  : Plot distribution of observed values
- [`plotFiltering()`](https://fmicompbio.github.io/mutscan/reference/plotFiltering.md)
  : Visualize the filtering procedure
- [`plotMeanDiff()`](https://fmicompbio.github.io/mutscan/reference/plotMeanDiff.md)
  : Construct an MA (mean-difference) plot
- [`plotPairs()`](https://fmicompbio.github.io/mutscan/reference/plotPairs.md)
  : Make pairs plot of selected assay from a SummarizedExperiment object
- [`plotTotals()`](https://fmicompbio.github.io/mutscan/reference/plotTotals.md)
  : Plot the column totals of a selected assay
- [`plotVolcano()`](https://fmicompbio.github.io/mutscan/reference/plotVolcano.md)
  : Construct a volcano plot
- [`relabelMutPositions()`](https://fmicompbio.github.io/mutscan/reference/relabelMutPositions.md)
  : Relabel the positions of mutations in the designated ID
- [`summarizeExperiment()`](https://fmicompbio.github.io/mutscan/reference/summarizeExperiment.md)
  : Summarize and collapse multiple mutational scanning experiments
